title: Health-SCORE: Towards Scalable Rubrics for Improving Health-LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2601.18706v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Rubrics are essential for evaluating open-ended LLM responses, especially in safety-critical domains such as healthcare. However, creating high-quality and domain-specific rubrics typically requires significant human expertise time and development cost, making rubric-based evaluation and training difficult to scale. In this work, we introduce Health-SCORE, a generalizable and scalable rubric-based training and evaluation framework that substantially reduces rubric development costs without sacrificing performance. We show that Health-SCORE provides two practical benefits beyond standalone evaluation: it can be used as a structured reward signal to guide reinforcement learning with safety-aware supervision, and it can be incorporated directly into prompts to improve response quality through in-context learning. translated_title: Health-SCORE：迈向可扩展的评分标准以改进医疗健康大语言模型
translated_abstract: 评分标准（rubrics）对于评估开放式大语言模型（LLM）响应至关重要，尤其是在医疗健康这类安全关键领域。然而，创建高质量且具备领域针对性的评分标准通常需要大量的人类专业时间与开发成本，使得基于评分标准的评估与训练难以规模化。在这项工作中，我们提出了Health-SCORE，一个通用且可扩展的基于评分标准的训练与评估框架，它能在不牺牲性能的前提下大幅降低评分标准的开发成本。我们展示了Health-SCORE在独立评估之外的两大实用优势：它可以用作结构化的奖励信号，指导带有安全感知监督的强化学习；同时它还可以直接融入提示中，通过上下文学习提升响应质量。在开放式医疗健康任务上，Health-SCORE实现了与人工创建评分标准相当的评估质量，同时显著降低了成本。
tldr: Health-SCORE是一个可扩展的基于评分标准的医疗健康大语言模型训练与评估框架，能大幅降低评分标准开发成本，既可作为安全感知强化学习的结构化奖励信号，也可融入提示通过上下文学习提升模型响应质量。
